{{nihongo|'''Kiburi Shrine'''|来振神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Mino Province]].

===History===
According to shrine tradition, it was founded in {{ill|725|ab|725|af|725|am|725 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|725|ar|725|ary|725|ast|725|az|725|azb|۷۲۵ (میلادی)|be|725|be_x_old|725|bg|725|bn|৭২৫|bpy|মারি ৭২৫|br|725|bs|725.|ca|725|cdo|725 nièng|ceb|725|ckb|٧٢٥|crh|725|cs|725|cv|725|cy|725|da|725|de|725|el|725|eml|725|eo|725|es|725|et|725|eu|725|fa|۷۲۵ (میلادی)|fi|725|fo|725|fr|725|fy|725|ga|725|gan|725年|gd|725|gl|725|he|725|hi|725|hr|725.|ht|725 (almanak jilyen)|hu|725|hy|725|id|725|io|725|is|725|it|725|ja|725年|jv|725|ka|725|kaa|725|kk|725 жыл|ko|725년|la|725|lb|725|lij|725|lmo|725|lt|725 m.|map_bms|725|mdf|725|mg|725|mhr|725|mk|725|mr|इ.स. ७२५|mrj|725 и|ms|725|mzn|۷۲۵|nah|725|nap|725|nds|725|new|सन् ७२५|nl|725|nn|725|no|725|nrm|725|nso|725|oc|725|or|୭୨୫|os|725-æм аз|pl|725|pnb|725|pt|725|qu|725|ro|725|ru|725 год|rue|725|sa|७२५|scn|725|sd|725ع|sh|725.|shn|725|si|725|sk|725|sl|725|smn|725|sq|725|sr|725|su|725|sv|725|sw|725|tg|Соли 725|th|พ.ศ. 1268|tk|725|tl|725|tly|725|tr|725|tt|725 ел|uk|725|ur|725ء|uz|725|vec|725|vi|725|war|725|wuu|725年|xmf|725|zh|725年|zh_min_nan|725 nî|zh_yue|725年|qid=Q23552}} ({{ill|Jinki (era)|de|Jinki|es|Jinki (era)|fa|جینکی (دوره)|fr|Ère Jinki|ia|Jinki|id|Jinki|ja|神亀|ko|진키|pt|Jinki|ru|Дзинки|simple|Jinki (era)|sr|Џинки (ера)|tr|Jinki|uk|Дзінкі|zh|神龜 (日本)|zh_yue|神龜|qid=Q1373210}} 2). On lunar June 18 of Jinki 2, golden-colored snow reportedly fell on the summit of Mt. Hakusan in Ōno District of Mino Province. This phenomenon was interpreted by oracle as the descent of {{ill|Kikurihime|Q11619891|qid=Q11619891|lt=Hakusan-hime-no-Kami}}, and a shrine was built and worshiped on Mt. Hakusan summit. At this time, the nearby {{ill|East Asian Yogācāra|bn|পূর্ব এশীয় যোগাচার|de|Faxiang zong|es|Yogacara de Asia oriental|fa|یوگه‌چاره شرق آسیا|hu|Kelet-ázsiai jógácsára|id|Yogacara Asia Timur|it|Buddismo Fǎxiāng|ja|法相宗|ko|법상종|no|Faxiang zong|pl|Faxiang|ru|Фасян|uk|Фасян|vi|Pháp tướng tông|zh|法相宗|zh_yue|法相宗|qid=Q349849}} temple Shinpuku-ji was renamed {{ill|Kiburi-ji|arz|كيبورى جى|ja|来振寺|qid=Q11523695}}.

In {{ill|1530|ab|1530|af|1530|als|1530|am|1530 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1530|ar|1530|ary|1530|arz|1530|ast|1530|avk|1530|az|1530|azb|۱۵۳۰ (میلادی)|ban|1530|bar|1530|bcl|1530|be|1530|be_x_old|1530|bg|1530|bn|১৫৩০|bpy|মারি ১৫৩০|br|1530|bs|1530.|ca|1530|cdo|1530 nièng|ceb|1530|ckb|١٥٣٠|crh|1530|cs|1530|cv|1530|cy|1530|da|1530|de|1530|diq|1530|el|1530|eml|1530|eo|1530|es|1530|et|1530|eu|1530|fa|۱۵۳۰ (میلادی)|fi|1530|fo|1530|fr|1530|frr|1530|fur|1530|fy|1530|ga|1530|gan|1530年|gcr|1530|gd|1530|gl|1530|gv|1530|he|1530|hi|१५३०|hif|1530|hr|1530.|ht|1530 (almanak jilyen)|hu|1530|hy|1530|ia|1530|id|1530|ilo|1530|io|1530|is|1530|it|1530|ja|1530年|jv|1530|ka|1530|kaa|1530|kk|1530 жыл|ko|1530년|krc|1530 джыл|ksh|Joohr 1530|la|1530|lb|1530|lfn|1530|lij|1530|lld|1530|lmo|1530|lt|1530 m.|lv|1530. gads|mai|१५३०|map_bms|1530|mdf|1530|mg|1530|mhr|1530|mi|1530|min|1530|mk|1530|mr|इ.स. १५३०|mrj|1530 и|ms|1530|my|၁၅၃၀|nah|1530|nap|1530|nds|1530|new|सन् १५३०|nl|1530|nn|1530|no|1530|nrm|1530|nso|1530|olo|1530|or|୧୫୩୦|os|1530-æм аз|pa|1530|pl|1530|pnb|1530|pt|1530|qu|1530|ro|1530|ru|1530 год|rue|1530|sa|१५३०|sah|1530|sc|1530|scn|1530|sd|1530ع|se|1530|sh|1530.|shn|1530|simple|1530|sk|1530|sl|1530|smn|1530|sq|1530|sr|1530|su|1530|sv|1530|sw|1530|ta|1530|tg|Соли 1530|th|พ.ศ. 2073|tk|1530|tl|1530|tly|1530|tr|1530|tt|1530 ел|uk|1530|ur|1530ء|uz|1530|vec|1530|vi|1530|vls|1530|wa|1530|war|1530|wuu|1530年|xmf|1530|yi|1530|zea|1530|zh|1530年|zh_min_nan|1530 nî|zh_yue|1530年|qid=Q6429}} ({{ill|Kyōroku|Q1193418|qid=Q1193418}} 3), floods damaged buildings at the foot, and in {{ill|1560|Q6613|qid=Q6613}} ({{ill|Eiroku|Q1143341|qid=Q1143341}} 3), it was burned by {{ill|Oda Nobunaga|Q171411|qid=Q171411}}, and the temple complex was lost.
